records.rationale: The stage decorations, checkerboard covering, and floorboards remain distinct. Visible grain and mild softness affect the room, especially darker areas, while the main scene remains readable and its brighter surfaces retain detail.

Dense colored grain is plainly visible across the sky, building walls, shadows, and hillside. Major shapes and edges remain clear, while the pervasive noise interferes with surface textures and fine detail.

Dense colored grain covers the frame, reducing fine detail in the stage decorations, lettering, and floor. Dark stage areas lose additional information, and small details appear soft despite recognizable outlines.

Grain is visible across the skin, curtains, and clothing, and facial and hair details are softened. The eyes, face outline, and fingers remain clearly identifiable, supporting the stated limitation in fine detail.

Bicycle lettering, frames, spokes, and background architecture are clearly resolved. Exposure preserves useful detail in the bright scene, colors are plausible, and no material compression or processing artifacts are apparent.

Strong blur extends across foreground runners and distant scenery. Faces, shirt graphics, race numbers, vegetation, and building edges are smeared, leaving broad shapes and colors but little fine detail.

Building outlines, exposure, and colors are readable, and texture detail is reduced. However, dense colored grain covers the sky, white walls, and shaded building surfaces; calling this noise mild materially understates its pervasive visibility.

Pervasive colored grain and softness reduce detail, while glass reflections overlap the firearms and weaken their local contrast. The firearms remain recognizable, but the small exhibit labels are difficult to resolve, supporting the limited-detail caveat.
The central structure has broad, diffuse contours and blurred architectural bands. Surrounding leaves merge into soft patches, with no crisply resolved surface texture or foliage detail.

The foreground lumber grain, dirt clumps, and pipes are distinguishable. Deep shade conceals portions of the trunks and ground, while the large bright sky area is nearly white and featureless, supporting the identified exposure limitations.

The leaf veins and droplets are distinctly resolved, and the insect's body, legs, and antennae remain visible. Exposure retains the leaf's texture. The dark background is smooth and defocused with modest grain; small differences in perceived sharpness do not materially contradict the explanation.
Extreme blur reduces the central dark form and surrounding greenery to broad, indistinct shapes. Fine architectural or leaf detail is not visibly resolved anywhere in the image.

The package appears dim and visibly grainy, with softened lettering and blurred food illustration details. Smaller text is difficult to resolve, so the stated effects of noise and soft focus are supported.

A large saturated reflection obscures the middle of the box and part of its title. Remaining lettering is readable and the coins are recognizable, though their fine markings are soft. General softness and modest grain are visible.

Dense vertical magenta, purple, and dark stripes replace roughly the left third of the scene. The remaining kitchen objects show visible grain and softness, especially the unreadable foreground package text.

Strong blur softens the package boundary and lettering throughout, while conspicuous grain covers the background and package. The large brand remains recognizable, but smaller print and food details are smeared and difficult to inspect.

The thermometer is recognizable, but its logo and casing edges are visibly soft. Its dark digital display extends beyond the bottom image boundary, leaving some digits cut off. These observations support the explanation and limited-detail caveat.
Most of the frame is nearly black. A dim diagonal transition along the left is visibly grainy, with no identifiable objects or useful fine detail in either the lighter area or deep shadows.

Balcony lines, windows, boats, and individual water ripples are clearly resolved. The blue sky and water retain smooth or naturally textured appearance, with readable highlights and no conspicuous compression blocks or processing artifacts.

Hair, facial features, and molded clothing textures are clearly visible, particularly on the left figure. The right figure is somewhat softer, as acknowledged. Bright highlights preserve substantial surface detail, colors are plausible, and the background is smooth.

Leaf veins and flower outlines are sharp, with softer background ground cover. However, substantial areas of both pale flowers are washed out to nearly featureless white, losing petal texture; the unqualified exposure claim overstates the visible result.

All four jets have distinct silhouettes, legible canopy and tail markings, and sufficient contrast against the smooth gray sky. Fine detail is slightly soft, but there is no conspicuous grain or blur that impairs the aircraft.

Writing on the central orange and left green notes is clearly legible with strong contrast. Slight grain and softness are visible, especially on peripheral notes and the dark background, without materially obscuring the main text.

Cracked plaster, exposed masonry, wire mesh, and wood grain are crisply resolved. Surface colors and bright areas retain useful texture, while the deepest parts of the window have less visible detail.

explanation_support.sample_selection: 24 cases selected before image requests; 12 controlled, 6 VizWiz, 6 standalone.
explanation_support.scope: Explanations only; auditors received no scores or references. These counts do not estimate support across all 200 cases.

historical_comparison: Different images and delivered views prevent a paired improvement or causal model comparison.
inference_limit: Bootstrap intervals describe sample variability conditional on the frozen assistant judgments; they do not measure reference uncertainty or human accuracy.

severity_ordering.interpretation: Diagnostic only: transform severity is not human ground truth and does not fix an expected score.

study_design: Fresh descriptive 200-image sample; no paired historical baseline.
